intro: The Pentair FRP Pressure Vessel 844 is a high-quality fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) pressure vessel designed for residential, commercial, and light industrial water treatment applications. With a 32.9-litre storage capacity, this compact vessel is ideal for water softeners, multimedia filters, activated carbon filters, and other filtration systems where reliable performance and corrosion resistance are essential.
